data.description: The raw data string used to generate QR code, it should be used together with QR code library.

expires_at.description: The date (unix timestamp) when the PIX expires.

hosted_instructions_url.description: The URL to the hosted pix instructions page, which allows customers to view the pix QR code.

image_url_png.description: The image_url_png string used to render png QR code

image_url_svg.description: The image_url_svg string used to render svg QR code
